title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: S is a base scheme and G is an S-form of PGL(2)_S. P is the associated Severi–Brauer scheme of relative dimension 1, a twisted P^1 or conic bundle. M is the associated rank-4 Azumaya algebra. N_x is the rank-1 'nilpotent' sub-Module attached to a section x of P.

What the page claims:
- G can be written as the automorphism group of a rank-2 vector bundle F as soon as P has a section x over S.
- Equivalently, G has a Borel subgroup over S, whose unipotent radical is the 'additive Borel subgroup' L.
- One can choose F explicitly. P \ {x} is an affine-line bundle, i.e. a torsor under the line bundle N = Hom(F/D, D). This torsor is classified by a class in H^1(S,N) = Ext^1(O_S,N). Take F to be the corresponding extension 0 → N → F → O_S → 0.
- Then P = P(F) ≅ P̌(F). In rank 2, lines D correspond to hyperplanes, i.e. to lines D° of the dual F̌. Sections of P correspond to rank-1 sub-bundles D ⊂ F that are locally direct summands.
- The Azumaya algebra becomes M = End(F) ≅ F̌ ⊗ F.
- The rank-1 sub-Module attached to the section x_D is N = D° ⊗ D, where D° = (F/D)^∨ ⊂ F̌. Its sections are the endomorphisms u with u(F) ⊂ D and u(D) = 0. This is the square-zero radical of the Borel subalgebra (Lie algebra of L) stabilizing D.
- With the normalization F/D = O_S one gets D = N, consistent with the extension above.

Role in the manuscript: this page sets up concrete linear-algebra coordinates. They are needed on the next page to prove the Proposition: a unipotent ε_1 = 1 + N_1 is regular, and ρ^{-1}(x_∞) avoids x_∞, iff c = λ_0 Tr ρ + Tr σ is invertible. That Proposition belongs to the study of the 'loop equation' [α,ρ] = [β,σ]γ for sections of forms of GL(2)/PGL(2) over a general base.
errors: (17) writes G = Aut_{O-Mod}(F). Strictly this is GL(F); a form of PGL(2) should be PGL(F) = Aut(F)/G_m, or equivalently Aut of P(F) or the automorphisms of the algebra End(F). This is an abuse of notation, harmless in context.

The phrase 'l'extension de O_S par N' must be read as an extension 0 → N → F → O_S → 0 (F/D ≅ O_S, D ≅ N). The opposite reading would not give the torsor structure on P \ {x} correctly. Not an error, but ambiguous as written.

ideas.what: A form of PGL2 (equivalently a conic bundle / rank-4 Azumaya algebra) whose Severi–Brauer scheme has a section is PGL(F) for a rank-2 vector bundle F; Borel subgroups correspond to sections of P.
ideas.modern_name: Triviality of the Brauer class iff the Severi–Brauer scheme has a section; Borel subgroups = sections of the flag variety
ideas.usually_credited_to: Châtelet (fields); Grothendieck (schemes, Brauer group papers, SGA3)
ideas.where_published: Le groupe de Brauer I (Dix exposés); SGA3 Exp. XXII–XXVI

ideas.what: P \ {x} is an affine-line bundle, a torsor under N = Hom(F/D, D), classified by Ext^1(O_S,N). The corresponding extension gives F with P = P(F).
ideas.modern_name: Affine bundle classified by H^1(S,N); projective bundle of an extension

ideas.what: End(F) ≅ F̌ ⊗ F, and the nilradical of the Borel stabilizing D is D° ⊗ D = {u : u(F) ⊂ D, u(D) = 0}.
ideas.modern_name: Lie algebra of the unipotent radical of a Borel subgroup of GL2/PGL2

deep.surprise_reason: Standard set-up material: split forms of PGL2 given by a section of the conic, the projective bundle of an extension, and the nilradical of a Borel. It serves as preparation for the Proposition on the next page and contains nothing new to a specialist.
transcription_corrections: The '447' at the top is Grothendieck's own page numbering; '295' at the bottom is the archive page.
Line beginning '(c'est le cas': the manuscript reads 'C'est le cas dès qu'on a une section x de P sur S, i.e. un sous-groupe additif borélien L de G sur S' (a new sentence, no opening parenthesis).
In (17) the subscript is 'O_S-Mod'. In (19) the tensor product is '⊗_{O_S}'.
Before (20) the text reads roughly 'associé à la section x_D de P est aussi celui que' followed by a struck-out symbol; the sentence is incomplete in the manuscript.
